Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Jim Jordan is credited on 504 distinct recordings across 8 programs from 1935-10-07 through 1981-12-25. Documented roles include performer on 504 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 496 recordings; 496 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Crime and Peter Chambers (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Lum and Abner (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Sears Radio Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Big Show (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Lone Ranger (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Fibber McGee (496 portrayals).
